test_insert_categorical_index: test the CategoricalIndex.insert method to insert elements at specified positions
test_delete_categorical_index: test the CategoricalIndex.delete method to remove elements at specified positions
test_is_monotonic_categorical: test the CategoricalIndex.is_monotonic_increasing and is_monotonic_decreasing properties with ordered and unordered categories
test_drop_duplicates_categorical: test the CategoricalIndex.drop_duplicates and duplicated methods to remove or identify duplicate values
test_unique_categorical_index: test the CategoricalIndex.unique method to return unique values from a categorical index
